ls-precision-report.description: Run LS network precision contributor report and create a GitHub issue body
ls-precision-report.prompt: Run python scripts/prepare_network_precision_contributor_report.py --runner <your-github-handle> --output reports/network_precision_contributor_report.md, then read the generated report and format it as a GitHub issue comment body using the contributor issue template at .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/network_precision_contributor_run.md

ls-probe-roster.description: Show which LS actors are ready or unavailable on this environment
ls-probe-roster.prompt: Run python scripts/run_model_roster_depth_probe.py --json and display the roster table: which actors are ready, which are unavailable, and what they are missing

ls-probe-precision.description: Run the LS network precision gain probe and show results
ls-probe-precision.prompt: Run python scripts/run_network_precision_gain_demo.py --json and display the precision scores: measured_route_reward_gain, network_precision_gain_over_baseline, stack_added_gain_over_cooperation, and score_ratio_vs_baseline
